common.reportWithoutLoginHint: No account needed for an emergency report.

errors.photoRequired: That file is not a supported photo or video.
errors.gpsFailed: Could not get GPS. Pick a place below.
errors.samplePhoto: Could not load sample photo. Try uploading your own.

home.blurb: Tell us what happened and where. UGNAI helps organize your report for disaster responders.
home.noLoginNeeded: No login. No perfect report needed.
home.whatToDo: What do you need to do?
home.reportFor: Who are you reporting this incident for?
home.needHelpHint: Ask for help for yourself or someone else.
home.reportHazardHint: Report flooding, damage, or an unsafe area.
home.checkReportHint: Use your reference number to see updates.
home.avoidFloodBody: Move to higher ground if safe. Do not walk or drive through floodwater.
home.disclaimer: Online reports are reviewed, but assistance and response times are not guaranteed.
home.tipHigher: Move to higher ground if water is rising
home.tipPhone: Keep your phone charged for updates

danger.immediateBody: Call the national emergency hotline. Do not wait for an online update.

intent.needHelpSub: For you or someone else in danger
intent.reportHazardSub: Flooding, damage, or an unsafe area

situation.title: Tell us what happened
situation.subtitle: Use your own words. A short description is enough.
situation.example: Floodwater is knee-deep outside our home. Three people, including my elderly mother, need help getting to a safe place.
situation.typeOrVoice: You can type, record your voice, or do both.
situation.recordHint: Tap to start. You can listen and remove it before sending.
situation.voiceUnsupported: This browser cannot record audio. Allow mic access or try Chrome/Safari.
situation.photoHint: A photo of the scene is required for review. Only take one if it is safe. JPG or PNG, up to 10 MB.
situation.aiTitle: AI can help organize your report
situation.aiNote: It may suggest a clearer summary or category. You will review and can edit every suggestion. AI can make mistakes.
situation.missingOk: Missing details will not stop an emergency report.
situation.startKnowBody: What happened? Who needs help? You can leave out details you do not know.
situation.noAccountNote: No account needed. Share only what you know. You can add details later.

location.title: Where is help needed?
location.subtitle: An approximate location is okay. Add what you know.
location.gpsHint: Uses GPS with your permission. Check the pin before sending.
location.pinNear: Pin is near {place}, not an exact address.
location.mapHint: Tap the map to place the pin.
location.landmarkHint: A familiar place can help responders find you.
location.unsureTitle: Not sure of the exact location?
location.unsureBody: You can continue with a barangay or landmark. Add or correct the location later.
location.noGpsBody: Search for a barangay or describe a nearby school, hall, road, or other landmark.

review.title: Check your report
review.subtitle: Make sure this is right. You can change any detail before sending.
review.aiSuggestionBody: Category: {category}. These are suggestions, not verified facts. Use Edit above to correct them.
review.approxPin: Approximate map pin · exact address not provided
review.mobileHint: PH mobile · +639 plus 10 digits. Responders use this to call you.
review.assistBody: Sending a report does not mean a responder is assigned. If you are in immediate danger, call 911.
review.consent: By submitting, you allow this report to be shared with disaster response teams for review and coordination.
review.saveConsent: By saving, you allow this report to be shared with disaster response teams for review and coordination.
review.submitEvenMissing: You can submit even if some details are missing.
review.saveEvenMissing: You can save even if some details are missing.
review.nextBody: Your report is received for review. Assignment depends on available responders and resources.
review.disclaimer: UGNAI will not present unverified rescue or aid as confirmed.

confirm.title: Your report was received
confirm.body: Thank you. Your report is now under review.
confirm.noResponder: Your report is pending assignment. No responder is currently available. Assistance is not yet guaranteed.
confirm.next1Body: They may need more information before coordinating a response.
confirm.next2Body: Track your report for updates. There is no confirmed arrival time.
confirm.keepBody: Save or take a screenshot of this number. Use it to check updates without an account.

track.title: Track your report
track.subtitle: Check progress using your reference number. No login needed.
track.statusReviewBody: No responder is currently available. Resources are limited. No arrival time is confirmed, and assistance is not yet guaranteed.
track.statusRejectedBody: This report was rejected after review. No responder will be assigned. You can update details and resubmit if the situation is still real.
track.statusAssignedBody: A responder or investigator has been linked to this report. Track here for further updates.
track.statusProgressBody: Work on this report is underway. There is still no guaranteed arrival time.
track.statusCompletedBody: This report is marked done. Response work on this ticket is finished.
track.updateWaitingBody: No responder or response resource is available yet. Your report remains in the review queue. Check here for any assignment update.
track.updateReviewBody: The report is being assessed for coordination. This does not confirm that help is on the way.
track.updateRejectedBody: Review closed this report without assignment. No responder is linked.
track.updateReceivedBody: Your situation, approximate location, and attachments were received.
track.updateAssignedBody: A responder or investigator was linked to your report.
track.updateProgressBody: Teams are working this report. Check back here for completion.
track.updateHint: If your situation changes, add an update. Do not wait for an online response if you are in danger.
track.badFormat: Reference must look like CEB-CON-NANG-261017-0001 (from your confirmation screen).
track.notFound: No report found for {ref}. Check the number and try again.

auth.loginSubtitle: For residents only. Officers use the UGNAI web command center.
